provenance.index_profile: PER-ROW AXIS — every class runs under each cell of store{sqlite} x profile{resolved default, fast}; the cell is in the row id and in axis_note. GRAPHI_INDEX_PROFILE is CLEARED for the child and then set explicitly per cell, so an inherited value cannot silently change what was measured. The hermetic table's mem-store half is NOT here and is not claimed: no dispatch-driven full index can emit a MemStore envelope.

not_compared.disposition: Already dispositioned DOCUMENTED HARMLESS (Labs tier) at kill point K4, docs/adr/0004-ingest-recovery-disposition.md:37. This report cites that disposition and does not reopen it: extending the snapshot envelope would bump SnapshotFormatVersion, which is a product-byte change.

gate_note: W5.n / gate GA-LANG-yaml-G4: the real-repository PARSE-DETERMINISM matrix for yaml, crossed over store{sqlite} x profile{resolved default, fast}. IT IS NOT THE PRD FR-7 GO MATRIX and settles none of its rows. A PASS here is a DETERMINISM AND INTRA-FILE PARITY statement — two independent full passes over identical bytes serialise identically, and the incrementally-updated graph is byte-identical to a fresh full index of the same final tree — and never a CORRECTNESS statement about any symbol or edge, because parity compares two passes of the same rule. Correctness evidence for the extractor lives in core/parse/parser_yaml_test.go. No performance, latency or RSS figure is published here. This family cannot reach a publishable state on a tree whose declared class count crossed over the reachable axes is below 15 (PARITY-011), nor while the product binary differs from the candidate (D7DEBT-001).
